questions.text: Which one of the following is a closed form expression for the generating function of the sequence [latex]\left \{ a_{n} \right \}[/latex], where [latex]a_{n}=2n+3[/latex] for all n = 0, 1, 2,...?
questions.solution:
[latex]\sum(2n+3)x^n=2\sum nx^n+3\sum x^n=\frac{2x}{(1-x)^2}+\frac{3}{1-x}=\frac{2x+3(1-x)}{(1-x)^2}=\frac{3-x}{(1-x)^2}[/latex]

Answer: [latex]\frac{3-x}{(1-x)^2}[/latex]

questions.text:
A queue is implemented using a non-circular singly linked list. The queue has a head pointer and a tail pointer, as shown in the figure. Let n denote the number of nodes in the queue. Let enqueue be implemented by inserting a new node at the head, and dequeue be implemented by deletion of a node from the tail.

Which one of the following is the time complexity of the most time-efficient implementation of enqueue and dequeue, respectively, for this data structure?
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- Enqueue at the head: create a node and point it to the old head [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]\Theta(1)[/latex].
- Dequeue at the tail: removing the tail needs the node before it, and in a singly linked list that means walking from the head [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]\Theta(n)[/latex].

Answer: [latex]\Theta(1),\Theta(n)[/latex]

questions.text: Let [latex]\bigoplus[/latex] and [latex]\bigodot[/latex] denote the Exclusive OR and Exclusive NOR operations, respectively. Which one of the following is NOT CORRECT?
questions.solution:
Check option 4: [latex]P\oplus\bar P=1[/latex], so the left side is [latex]1\oplus Q=\bar Q[/latex]. [latex]P\odot\bar P=0[/latex], so the right side is [latex]0\odot\bar Q=\overline{0\oplus\bar Q}=Q[/latex]. [latex]\bar Q\ne Q[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] not correct.

Options 1-3 are standard identities.

Answer: Option 4

questions.text:
Consider the following processor design characteristics.
I. Register-to-register arithmetic operations only
II. Fixed-length instruction format
III. Hardwired control unit
Which of the characteristics above are used in the design of a RISC processor?
questions.solution:
RISC processors use load/store architecture (arithmetic only between registers), fixed-length instructions for easy decoding, and a fast hardwired control unit. All three apply.

Answer: I, II and III
